title: Prove exact distinguished-factor tariffs for dirty echo trees (no κ)
body:
## Summary

Scoped written proof with exact finite corroboration, produced by Nick Petalas. For the static ordered, parent-reserved dirty-echo grammar of Koroffstrogov's PR758, the least completed invocation multiplicity of one distinguished factor is exactly

```text
min multiplicity = 2^d
first d in 0..s with
ceil(i / 2^(s-d)) + ceil((n-1-i) / 2^(s-d)) <= 2^d - 1

s>=0, 1<=n<=2^s, 0<=i<n
```

A binary tree attains the bound even though higher arities can improve total weighted cost. At n=2^s-1, even positions need 2^(s-1) invocations and odd positions need 2^s. For seven factors and three dirty arrays, the individual minima are `(4,8,4,8,4,8,4)`. This is a new exact individual-factor price law and weighted lower bound, with every inverse and restoration call retained. No new kappa or selected-frontier change.

Only `research/distinguished-echo-factor/` is added. Credit Koroffstrogov / PR758 for the ordered weighted grammar and capacity lemma; androolloyd / PR673 for the echo and restoration; Dillon Amburgey / PR689, Sagar Thakrar / PR730, Ali Romman / PR744, Alexander Schwartzman / PR784, Gareth Davidson / PR887 and Chafik Boukhalfa / PR628 for the retained optimization, budget, formalization and rounded-leaf lineage. Nick Petalas / PR4862 studies total-unit-cost equality; its theorem is not used here. Dyadic trees and prefix coding are classical; no general literature-priority claim is made.

## Evidence

Before, PR758 supplies an all-arity weighted dynamic program, without the position-sensitive minimum for one factor. After, PROOF.md gives a binary replacement argument and exact prefix/suffix capacity criterion, plus a universal attaining construction. No predecessor executable, count, scientific result or optimizer is replayed or audited.

Local CPython 3.12.15 on macOS arm64 passes:

- 2,794 complete all-arity marked optima through six dirty arrays.
- Every ordered tree through eight leaves, 5,440 trees with 93,266 factor comparisons and 194 exact marked optima.
- 43,946 emitted binary witnesses, containing 6,435,096 leaf occurrences, through eight arrays; 2,035 parity-specialization cases through ten arrays.
- Thirteen invalid-input/tree rejections and four semantic controls, including false position-free and floor-rounded tariffs.
- Warning-strict normal and optimized direct replay, with identical generated hash-bound receipts. Each registered command was timed locally: 6.469 s normal and 6.702 s optimized, below the 120-second limits. These are bounded replay durations, without a performance-improvement claim.
- Registered metadata/pins and both complete replay commands; in-memory syntax/AST inspection and staged whitespace checks; exact committed bytes, modes and source ancestry for all seven package/input files.
- Official committed export integrity and read-only Git-free normal/optimized replay with an empty PATH. Both exported receipts equal the local receipts. Corrupting the external source proof rejects in both modes, and all seven exported payload hashes remain unchanged after restoration.

From the worktree root:

```sh
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -W error -B research/distinguished-echo-factor/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -O -W error -B research/distinguished-echo-factor/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/distinguished-echo-factor
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/distinguished-echo-factor --check-source-history --check-modes
```

Substitute another CPython 3.12 executable elsewhere. Expected markers: `PASS_DISTINGUISHED_ECHO_FACTOR`, `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE`, `PASS_RESEARCH_COMMIT_BYTES`. The verifier prints a generated receipt binding six package files and the unchanged source proof by SHA256. No handwritten receipt is used.

Base: canonical main `7c49fe32c55de02c2c873655c804b16e4c3fef0a`, priority revision eight, selected PR6030. The binding-only baseline passes. Live claims, local reservations, current-main README searches including the general formula/object, open/merged/account searches and cached overlap were checked again before committing. The cached scan covered 394 open PRs and 6,334 Discussion records with complete paging, but only 112 of 8,917 tracked notes were materialized locally. Sparse notes, arbitrary historical diffs and unpublished work remain coverage limits.

Coordination: https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19362439

## Limitations

This optimizes one designated factor at a time. The sum of individual weighted lower bounds need not be jointly attained. The proof requires static parent-reserved dirty arrays, ordered nonempty factors, fixed invocation prices and the complete retained restoration word. Connector reuse, clean checkpoints, alternative echo words, opened child bodies, reordered factors and arbitrary reversible circuits are outside its grammar. Different trees are not asserted to have identical rounded nonlinear errors.

The bounded reference constructor accepts at most ten arrays and 1024 factors; the written theorem is all-size. No actual native caller, complete physical movement/storage bill, precision/stock proof, compiler admission or analytic recovery is supplied. The unchanged unfavorable full-transform adapter is not reopened. The five selected framework assumptions remain. Independent human and formal proof-kernel review, predecessor or selected cold replay, Lean and Docker are unrun.

## Open next questions

When can several expensive factors attain their individual minima in one tree? Start with two marked positions and their dyadic path capacities, keeping every parent reservation and complete multiplier. The present result supplies no joint-attainment classification or full weighted optimum. A physical application first needs a distinct favorable complete supplier contract.

## Related open work

No other open PR computing this static reserved-scratch, distinguished-factor multiplicity was found in the complete cached open-PR body snapshot and refreshed live lists.

- #6411 prices external-source injections across completed partial linear updates. It has an observation/shifted-workspace contract, rather than a reserved-parent composition tree. No shared numerical claim is compared or recomputed here.

Merged #784/#887/#4862 concern the same static tree grammar's total unit-price bound and equality band. They are credited context, not open review work or results being rechecked.

The completion refresh inspected this account's eight open PRs created since the advance CLAIM, including this PR. The other seven concern regular matrix pencils, permutation circuits, weighted-path replay implementation, Desargues parameters, rounded-shear lattice closure, compact-control guards and prime production. None studies this static tree multiplicity, and no common numerical claim disagrees. No additional computations audited another contribution.
